# IaC fixtures

| Path | How it was made |
|---|---|
| `terraform/plan.json` | `terraform show -json` of `terraform/main.tf` (Terraform 1.14.8, provider `hashicorp/aws` 5.x, mock credentials) |
| `terraform/tofu-plan.json` | `tofu show -json` of the same project (OpenTofu) |
| `cloudformation/template.yaml`, `template.json` | Hand written to cover every resolver construct and mapped resource |
| `pulumi/stack-export.json`, `preview.json` | Hand written from the documented `pulumi stack export` and `pulumi preview --json` layouts. Not generated by a live Pulumi run. |

Regenerate the Terraform fixture:

```bash
cd tests/fixtures/iac/terraform
terraform init && terraform plan -out=plan.out && terraform show -json plan.out > plan.json
rm -rf .terraform .terraform.lock.hcl plan.out
```

The provider uses mock credentials and skips account lookups, so no AWS access is needed.
